z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c1: a, b, c zvese i ma integers.
z-m-18-01.title: Kana pane ma equations maviri, mhinduro inogara i peya imwe here?
z-m-18-01.topic: Ma systems e linear equations asina mhinduro kana ane mhinduro dzisingagumi
z-m-18-01.goal: Simbisa kuburikidza nekutarisa mhinduro, kutonga ruzivo, nemienzaniso yaunogadzira iwe pachako kuti kana ma linear equations maviri ane zvisingazivikanwi zviviri akaiswa pamwe chete, mhinduro inowira muzviitiko zvitatu (peya imwe, hapana, dzisingagumi), uye utsanangure kuti pamamiriro api chiitiko chipi chinoitika.
z-m-18-01.material:
Soyoung akati, "Kana pane ma linear equations maviri ane zvisingazivikanwi zviviri x ne y, kunogara kuine peya imwe chete (x, y) inogutsa ma equations ese panguva imwechete." Pano x ne y dzinogona kuva nhamba dzipi neimwe, uye ma equations ese i ma linear equations ane ma coefficients e integers. Soyoung anoda kutarisa pfungwa yake nesystem ye equations iri pazasi. Maitiro ekuverenga: 'x plus 2y equals 6', '2x plus 4y equals 10'.
  ㉠ x + 2y = 6
  ㉡ 2x + 4y = 10
z-m-18-01.thinking.0: Kutsvaga nokururamisa mutsetse mukugadzirisa umo mhedziso inobuda pasina nheyo
z-m-18-01.thinking.1: Kutonga kuti ruzivo rupi rwunodikanwa kuti usarudze huwandu hwemhinduro
z-m-18-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako zvirevo zvakati wandei zvinosangana nemamiriro uye kuzvitarisa
z-m-18-01.thinking.3: Kurongedza mamiriro umo chirevo che 'nguva dzose' chinoshanda
z-m-18-01.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti mhinduro yechirevo chomutsetse chine zvisingazikanwi zviviri ipeya (x, y)
z-m-18-01.prereq.1: Zvinoreva mhinduro yehurongwa hwezvirevo (peya inosangana nezvirevo zvose zviviri panguva imwe chete)
z-m-18-01.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwokuona chirevo chomutsetse ax+by=c semutsetse pachirongwa chekoodhineti (chiyero cheGredhi 8; hauna kudikanwa kuziva hukama nehuwandu hwemhinduro)
z-m-18-01.s.s1.prompt: Mukugadzirisa kuri pazasi, kwakanyorwa naSoyoung pa ㉠ ne ㉡, sarudza mutsetse mumwe umo nheyo dzokubuda nemhedziso dzashaikwa. Siya pfungwa yokutanga (chirevo chaSoyoung) kwechinguva uye utarise mutsetse nomutsetse kana zvirevo zvichishanda zvechokwadi.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.0: Isa (0, 0) kurutivi rwokuruboshwe rwechirevo ㉠, x + 2y = 6, uye utarise kana ichiva 6.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana mumutsetse 2, 2x + 4y imwe chete ichigona kuenzana nenhamba 12 ne 10 zvose panguva imwe chete.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.0: Kuwanza mativi ose ewo ㉠ x + 2y = 6 na 2 kunopa 2x + 4y = 12.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.1: Kuenzanisa chirevo ichi ne ㉡ 2x + 4y = 10, mativi okuruboshwe akafanana asi mativi okurudyi akasiyana, 12 ne 10.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.2: Saka x ne y zvose zvinoperera, saka x = 0, y = 0 ndiyo mhinduro.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka mhinduro yehurongwa uhwu hwezvirevo ndiyo peya imwe chete (0, 0).
z-m-18-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauteveri. Mumutsetse 2 zvakabuda kuti 2x + 4y imwe chete inofanira kuva 12 ne 10 zvose, zvichireva kuti haigone kugutswa nekukosha kupi zvako kwa x ne y. 'x ne y zvakaperera' hazvireve 'x ne y ndi 0.' Kana ukaisa (0, 0) mu ㉠, unowana 0 = 6, iyo isingashande. Mutsetse 4 mhedziso inotakura kukanganisa komutsetse 3.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.prompt: Siya ㉠ sezvayakaita uye chinja ㉡ kuva 2x + 4y = c. (c inogona kuva nhambaipi zvayo, uye hatisati tazivi kukosha kwayo. Kuverenga: '2x plus 4y inoenzana ne c') Nezvaunoziva izvozvi chete, unogona kutaura chii pamusoro pemhinduro yehurongwa uhwu hwezvirevo?
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora chirevo chaunowana nokuwanza mativi ose ewo ㉠ na 2 uye uchienzanise padivi nechimiro che ㉡.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa 12 nenhamba isiri 12 se c, imwe imwe, uye uedze kana zvirevo zviviri zvichiva mamiriro akafanana.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.a: Chero c iri yupi, mhinduro inogara yasarudzwa seyepeya imwe chete
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.a: Ichi chisarudzo chakatakura pfungwa yokutanga yokuti zvirevo zviviri zvinoreva peya imwe chete. Hauna kutarisa kuti rutivi rwokuruboshwe 2x + 4y ndinguva 2 yeye ㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.b: Chero c iri yupi, hapana x, y dzinogutsa zvirevo zvose zviviri
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.b: Wakazivisa kuti 'hazvingasangani nguva dzose' uchitarisa rutivi rwokuruboshwe rwe ㉡ chete. Hauna kufunga kana, zvichienderana nokukosha kwa c, zvirevo zviviri zvinogona kuva chirevo chimwe chete.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.c: Tinofanira kuziva kukosha kwa c. Zvichienderana na c, hapana mhinduro kana dzakawanda zvisina muganho
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.d: Kana c iri 12 hapana mhinduro, uye kune imwe c yose pane dzakawanda zvisina muganho
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakawana mamiriro maviri asi kuwirirana kwakapesana. Nyora iwe pachako kana ㉡ ichiva chirevo chimwe chete ne ㉠ kana 2x + 4y iri 12, nguva 2 yo 6.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.explain: Rutivi rwokuruboshwe rwe ㉡, 2x + 4y, rwunguva 2 yerutivi rwokuruboshwe rwe ㉠. Kana c = 12, ㉡ i ㉠ nemativi ose akapetwa kaviri, saka mamiriro akafanana uye pane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho, uye kana c isiri 12, 2x + 4y imwe chete inofanira kuva kukosha kusiri 12, nguva 2 yo 6, saka hapana mhinduro. Kuhurongwa uhwu hwezvirevo, hapana kukosha kwa c kunoita kuti mhinduro ive peya imwe chete. Saka kuti utaure nezvehuwandu hwemhinduro, unoda kukosha kwa c.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.prompt: Zvino gadzira hurongwa hwezvirevo ne ㉠ x + 2y = 6 husina mhinduro zvachose. Nyora chirevo chitsva se ax + by = c, uye ugadzire zvirevo zviviri zvakasiyana. (a, b, c dzinhamba dzakazara, a ne b hadzisi 0 uye imwe neimwe ine kukosha kwakakwana kwe 20 kana shoma, uye c ine kukosha kwakakwana kwe 100 kana shoma. 'ax + by = c' inoverengwa 'a x plus b y inoenzana ne c'.)
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rangarira zvakaitika mu s2 kana c isiri 12, uye uenzanise kuti hukama hupi hwakanga huri pakati pemakoefficient e x ne y ne ㉠ panguva iyoyo.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza a ne b, wobva wachinja c uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kana pane (x, y) inogutsa zvose chirevo ichocho ne ㉠. Unofanira kusiya c inoita kuti ive chirevo chimwe chete ne ㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c1: a, b, c dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c2: a ne b hadzifaniri kuva 0 uye dzine kukosha kwakakwana kwe 20 kana shoma, uye c ine kukosha kwakakwana kwe 100 kana shoma.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Makoefficient e x ne y ane reshiyo imwe chete ne ㉠ (koefficient ye y inguva 2 koefficient ye x).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Tarisa kana pane hukama hwakafanana pakati pemakoefficient e x ne y sepa ㉠. Nechimiro ichi, mitsetse inosangana papoinzi rimwe.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Nhamba isingachinji kurutivi rwokurudyi haisi chinowanzwa chakafanana sepa ㉠ (hachisi chirevo chimwe chete).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c4: Chirevo ichi chinova chirevo chimwe chete ne ㉠, saka pane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho. Kuti pasave nemhinduro, nhamba isingachinji kurutivi rwokurudyi inofanira kusiyana.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.explain: Ne (a, b, c) = (1, 2, 5), x + 2y yaifanira kuva 6 ne 5 zvose, saka hapana mhinduro. (2, 4, 7) ne (-3, -6, -4) zvakafanana. (2, 4, 12) inguva 2 ㉠, saka chirevo chimwe chete, uye (1, 3, 4) ine hukama hwakasiyana pakati pemakoefficient e x ne y, saka mitsetse inosangana papoinzi rimwe. Zvirevo zvinomirira mutsetse mumwe chete, se (2, 4, 7) ne (4, 8, 14), zvinoverengwa semumwe.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.prompt: Pindura Soyoung seizvi. Chirevo che 'Kana pane zvirevo zviviri, mhinduro nguva dzose ipeya imwe chete' chakarurama rinhi uye chakanganisa rinhi? Nyora mamiriro umo mhinduro iri peya imwe, hapana, kana dzakawanda zvisina muganho, uchizvibatanidza nechimiro chezvirevo (makoefficient nenhamba isingachinji kurutivi rwokurudyi).
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.0: Isa zvirevo zvawakagadzira mu s2 ne s3 mapeya neimwe neimwe ne ㉠, uye uenzanise kuti makoefficient nenhamba isingachinji kurutivi rwokurudyi zvinguva ingani ㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.1: Zviparadzanise kuva mapeya asina mhinduro, mapeya ane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho, nemapeya aive nepeya imwe, uye unyore chakasiyana nechega chega.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.placeholder: semuenzaniso, Kana makoefficient e x ne y mune zvirevo zviviri ari ..., ipapo ...
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakasiyana here kuti mamiriro asina mhinduro nemamiriro ane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho anobva muchimiro chezvirevo chipi nechipi?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Wakanyorawo here kuti peya imwe chete inobuda rinhi?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Wakapa here mienzaniso yenhamba sehumbowo, senge chirevo chawakagadzira mu s3 kana ㉠, ㉡?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.0: Chirevo chaSoyoung hachisi chechokwadi nguva dzose. Kana reshiyo yemakoefficient e x ne y ichisiyana pakati pezvirevo zviviri, mhinduro ipeya imwe. Kana reshiyo yemakoefficient yakafanana asi reshiyo yenhamba dzisingachinji ichisiyana, hapana mhinduro. Kana reshiyo yenhamba dzisingachinji yakafananawo, chirevo chimwe chete, saka pane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho. Semuenzaniso, x+2y=6 ne 2x+4y=10 hazvina mhinduro.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.1: Unogona kuzvifunga semitsetse miviri. Kana slope dzichisiyana, dzinosangana papoinzi rimwe, saka mhinduro ipeya imwe. Kana slope dzakafanana uye panopfuurwa pakasiyana, dzakafanana uye hadzimbosangani, saka hapana mhinduro. Kana dzichiwirirana zvachose, pane mhinduro dzakawanda zvisina muganho. Saka kungova nezvirevo zviviri hazvireve peya imwe nguva dzose.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Mhinduro yakatarisa graph. Panzvimbo pokuiratidza nemakoefficient nenhamba dzisingachinji, yakataura chinhu chimwe chete ichi ichishandisa slope ne 'panopfuura mutsetse.'
